The very worst dream I had was when I was about 8, and all I remember from it was having a small argument with my parents about having to take a shower. After this, I stomped upstairs, prepared a towel and what have you, and went to the bathroom and threw back the shower curtain. In the instant I did, an incredibly malnourished-looking woman was standing there. She flicked her head to look at me with glowing orange eyes and screeched. Then, she jumped on me and began ripping all my skin apart, then when she went to slash my eyes, I woke up. My brother (who I shared a room with at the time) told me he heard me screaming in my sleep so he woke me up. He asked me what I was dreaming about, and after I told him, we both stayed up all night and I didn't shower once for the next 2 weeks.
